title: Convergence Demand Queue
purpose: Machine-readable mirror of the Section-4 demand-queue table in convergence_demand_pipeline_plan.md. Each row maps an OPEN closure node whose latest verdict is 'mechanism unclear' or 'substrate ceiling' to the external AI-assembly project whose solution maps onto its mechanism gap, plus the intake action that terminates in REGISTERED candidate claims (never survey prose). The Sense step (plan Section 5 step 1, wired into /governance Step 6b) appends rows here; the Mine/Register steps execute them per row.

invariants.registers_claims_not_prose: Every executed row terminates in >=1 version-scoped candidate claim wired into the target node's depends_on with an arch-doc stub. 'Future-registration' prose is a pipeline failure.
invariants.v3_primacy: A row whose external mechanism maps onto a V4/V5-leaning substrate is tagged generation: v4_leaning|v5_leaning and MUST NOT place a build dependency on the v3 critical path (blocks_v3_critical_path stays false on every row). The pipeline surfaces ideas; it does not reprioritise v3.
invariants.biology_before_formal_definitions: Where an external mechanism instantiates a formal concept REE will own as an SD/MECH, commission a biology /lit-pull before registering.

intake_state_legend.NEW: no intake exists in REE_convergence yet
intake_state_legend.PARTIAL: an intake exists at the named sources/<name>/ path; extend it along the stated angle
intake_state_legend.COMPLETED: intake done; pull the adapter through to a registered claim
intake_state_legend.IN_FLIGHT: a row currently being executed by a chip/session (see in_flight pointer)

generation_legend.v3: mechanism maps onto existing V3 substrate / V3 claims; on the V3 work surface
generation_legend.v4_leaning: registers candidate claims tagged generation:v4 (preparatory only; off the v3 critical path)
generation_legend.v5_leaning: registers candidate claims tagged generation:v5 (preparatory only; off the v3 critical path)

routing_target_legend._purpose: The downstream action a dispatcher routes a row to once it is unblocked. Lets a router act on a demand without re-reading last_known_state_note prose.
routing_target_legend.convergence_intake: Mine a REE_convergence/sources/<name>/ source then Register candidate claim(s) into claims.yaml wired into the target node depends_on; the native route, used when the demand terminates in a NEW claim
routing_target_legend.design_query: Resolve a design fork on an already-registered claim; registers NO new claim; route to /thought-digestion or /claim-synthesis
routing_target_legend.experiment: Needs a discriminative run; route to /queue-experiment
routing_target_legend.decide_to_build: Claim(s) already registered; needs a decide-whether-to-build adjudication before any substrate build
routing_target_legend._note_lit_pull: A biology /lit-pull is NOT a routing_target -- it is a mandatory precondition sub-step of convergence_intake/design_query under the biology_before_formal_definitions invariant, not a terminal route

blocks_on_legend._schema: array of gate objects; [] means dispatchable now. Each entry: {kind: experiment|claim|substrate, id: <EXQ/MECH/node id>, clears_when: <one-line condition>, note: <why>}
blocks_on_legend._purpose: Encodes blockers that were previously prose-only in last_known_state_note so a dispatcher can check dispatchability without reading prose

completion_criterion_legend._schema: object {kind: claims_registered|design_resolved|experiment_pass|decision_recorded, detail: <one-line>, satisfied: <bool>}; the demand's exit gate (when is the demand satisfied)
completion_criterion_legend.claims_registered: satisfied once registered_candidate_claims is non-empty AND those claims are wired into the target node depends_on
completion_criterion_legend.design_resolved: satisfied once a design decision is recorded for the named fork (design_query rows)
completion_criterion_legend.experiment_pass: satisfied once the named EXQ passes (experiment rows)
completion_criterion_legend.decision_recorded: satisfied once a decide-whether-to-build verdict is logged
